title: pm-dispatch(grading): grade by impact — the maintainer-approved four-row table, MCP as the focus feature, p3 as the default for follow-ups and process tweaks
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② a maintainer ruling to write into the managed references (`lanes/skills.md`: 「改规则(归属、门禁、上限、车道边界)先立决策卡,裁后本域写」). The ruling is already made, so this is the write-up card, not a decision card. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

您在 2026-11-12 分诊会话里接受了分诊的优先级建议（「接受你的优先级建议」「接手你的优先级建议，并重新评估现有的p2」），重点功能定为「MCP」，并授权「如果需要的话可以立卡修改 skills」。这张卡把新定级表写进技能参考文件。从批准当轮起，分诊已按新表定级，并按新表重评现有的 p2。

## The ruling (maintainer, verbatim, 2026-11-12, triage#1 session)

- 「接受你的优先级建议」 · 「接手你的优先级建议，并重新评估现有的p2」 · 「如果需要的话可以立卡修改 skills」
- Focus feature: 「重点功能（ MCP）」

The table the maintainer accepted:

| Grade | When |
|---|---|
| p0 | `main` or the merge queue is red; a release blocker, raised to p0 for the release window only and returned to p1 after the release ships (the 18.4.0 practice) |
| p1 | data silently wrong or lost; a security boundary; a user cannot complete a core task and has no workaround; a protocol addition the release needs |
| p2 | a user-visible defect with a workaround; an ordinary protocol addition; a process or tooling card that blocks p1 work |
| p3 (default) | review nits, loose ends, docs and skills follow-ups after something lands, other process improvements. Raised to p2 when a real user can hit what the card describes |

Focus-feature weighting: a user- or agent-reachable defect in a maintainer-named focus feature goes one row up. The list is short and the maintainer confirms it. Today it holds one entry: **MCP** (the `/api/v1/mcp` door, its tools, and the prompts and skills it serves). Pure prose follow-ups get no bump.

## Work

1. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md` 〈定级判据〉: replace the protocol-class rule (「此类任何车道皆 p1 + 在研大版 `target:`」) with the table above. A protocol addition is p1 only when the release needs it, and p2 otherwise. Keep the checklist-item, false-green and reach-bound clauses; reconcile where they conflict and name the conflict in the PR.
2. `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md`: one line pointing to the table and the focus list, with the list's current value (MCP) and the rule that the maintainer confirms changes to it.
3. The release-window rule: blockers are p0 only, with no `target:` label (「阻塞卡升 p0，不需要打 target:18.4.0」), and return to p1 after the release. Reconcile with every reference that still asks for `target:<major>` as the blocker mark (`seat-lifecycle.md`'s health metric 「发版阻塞 = 三仓 `target:<major>` 之和」 among them).
4. Regrading existing cards is out of scope. Triage does that on the cards themselves.

## Acceptance

The references state the table, the focus list and the release-window rule once each, with no remaining text that grades every protocol addition p1 or marks a blocker by `target:`. The skills gates are green.

## Reader
